verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, DLC provenance, mechanics, Counter Skills taxonomy, and Ultimate Finish evidence. Preserve unsupported numeric/probability fields as null.
research_scope: Heroic Counter — Strike Super / universal counter research.

verification_audit.method: Compared current repository coverage with Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, the Dragon Ball reference, the all-186 Parallel Quest reward guide, and official Bandai Namco/Dragon Ball DLC documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research batch for Heroic Counter was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike; its universal-counter behavior is represented by the Counter Skills taxonomy without creating a second canonical identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Heroic Counter as a Strike Super and Counter Skill. The Counter Skill reference places it in the universal-counter group, meaning it can respond to both melee/Strike and Ki attacks.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Heroic Counter is obtained from Parallel Quest 155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!. The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Heroic Counter under PQ155 Basic Reward. A separate quest guide also lists Heroic Counter among PQ155 rewards.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: PQ155 is part of HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 1. Official Bandai Namco documentation identifies HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 1 as adding four Parallel Quests and additional moves, while the official Dragon Ball site identifies Gamma 2 and his Xenoverse 2 attacks as Pack 1 content.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required is false because the all-186 Parallel Quest reward guide explicitly places Heroic Counter in PQ155 Basic Reward rather than an Ultimate Finish reward slot. No reviewed source establishes a separate Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100. No reliable reviewed source establishes a stamina cost or drop probability, so those fields remain null.

records.name: Heroic Counter
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Heroic Counter under PQ155 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: A Strike Super counter that uses a heroic pose and barrier-like stance to intercept an incoming attack, then vanishes behind the opponent for a spinning kick; additional input can trigger a warp attack without relying on the initial counter hit.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a defensive heroic pose that counters an attack and warps behind the opponent for a spinning kick. Additional input can be used to perform the warp/attack sequence separately. The Counter Skill reference classifies Heroic Counter as a universal counter capable of responding to both melee/Strike and Ki attacks. Exact frame data and numeric damage are not promoted to canonical data.
records.acquisition_notes: The Future Warrior can obtain Heroic Counter from PQ155. The all-186 quest guide places it in the Basic Reward list; an independent PQ155 guide also lists Heroic Counter among the quest rewards. The exact random-drop probability is unresolved.
records.pve_notes: PQ155 farming is the documented Future Warrior route. Basic-reward evidence does not establish an Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.pvp_notes: Universal counter behavior allows Heroic Counter to respond to both melee/Strike and Ki attacks. Community discussion reports that the skill also has utility through its additional-input warp, but detailed matchup and frame behavior is version-sensitive.
